**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or inducement covenant binding Northwind. § 12.3 goes further and affirmatively records that Customer is free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and has made no no-hire commitment. § 30.1's personnel reference is only an independent-contractor allocation, and § 16 imposes confidentiality duties only. No redline proposed.
